name: Shojo Mama
source:
The protagonist is living in a motherless home. His father is always out for business as well so he starves for parental affection.

His father found a girl and will marry her in his return from business trip. His new mother has to boot up into his family so she came to their home to live there in advance. This delighted him very much and welcomes her wholeheartedly. His sister, who has an Electra complex, welcome her in a bad grace.

His new mother, who is still a virgin and have no experience with parenting, receives the helping hand of their maid. The maid, however, took advantage of her naivety and taught her a different kind of "parenting".

[from [url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?p=1339889#post1339889]kaorinusantara[/url]]
translation:
主角成長在一個沒有母親的家庭，父親也總因工作外出，因此他極度渴望親情。

父親找到一名準備結婚的對象，打算出差回來後迎娶她。為了提前適應這個家庭，新媽媽先一步搬進他們家。主角欣喜萬分，全心全意歡迎她；有戀父情結的妹妹卻態度勉強，十分不情願。

新媽媽依然是處女，也毫無養育子女的經驗，於是向家中女僕尋求幫助。然而，女僕利用她的天真，教給她另一種「育兒」方式。

[譯自[url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?p=1339889#post1339889]kaorinusantara[/url]]
